notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Ticktock is updated to version v1.1

What's New

Added progress bar for stages (can be disabled in options)
Added popup text when dash is recharging
Added new effects when player is hit
Added new tutorial text in Denial (destroy all enemies to advance)

Changes

Reworked Covenant's sound effects
Changed player's font appearance
Rebalanced levels Denial, Anger, Anger Nightmare, Acceptance (easier)

Fixes
Fixed sprite ordering
